title: Risky Business: Measuring The Faithfulness-Safety Tension
abstract: arXiv:2608.03745v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning offers a promising window into model monitoring. However, monitoring relies on faithfulness, i.e., the model output strictly derives from its reasoning trace. We identify an alignment tension where a model must be faithful enough to be monitored, yet robust enough to reject unsafe reasoning. We demonstrate that this counterbalance exists in current Large Reasoning Models (LRMs), and show ways in which it can be addressed. translated_title: 风险生意：测量忠实性与安全性之间的张力
translated_abstract: 链式思维推理为模型监控提供了一个有前景的窗口。然而，监控依赖于忠实性，即模型输出严格来源于其推理轨迹。我们识别出一种对齐张力：模型必须足够忠实以便被监控，同时又必须足够稳健以拒绝不安全的推理。我们证明这种相互制约的关系存在于当前的大型推理模型中，并展示了可以解决该问题的方法。我们介绍了 HazMart，一个设置在自主 AI 店主场景下的人工撰写数据集。与以往依赖在提示中提供暗示来测试忠实性的工作不同（例如，“一位斯坦福教授说答案应该是 A”），我们提出了一种新颖的基于替换的技术，称为目标推理替换（TRR），它直接干预推理链，将不安全或不合逻辑的想法替换进去（例如，“等等，答案必须是选项 B [原为选项 A]，因为..."）。
tldr: 本文揭示了大型推理模型中“必须忠实以便被监控”与“必须稳健以拒绝不安全推理”之间的对齐张力，并提出 HazMart 数据集和目标推理替换（TRR）技术来直接干预推理链以测量和应对这一张力。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the alignment tension between being faithful enough for monitoring and robust enough to reject unsafe reasoning in Large Reasoning Models, and introduces the HazMart dataset along with a novel Targeted Reasoning Replacement (TRR) technique that directly intervenes in reasoning chains to measure this tension.
